title: Smoke over the Vale
summary: The Redhand Company are squatting in the Tithe Mill again, burning the miller's carts for warmth. Maudry Fenn wants them gone before the tithe grain goes with them.

steps.journal: Drive the Redhand out of the Tithe Mill, up the river from Thornwick. Win four fights there.

objectives.label: Fights won in the Tithe Mill

ready: Tell Osric Hale at the Watch post by the well. The Watch will want to know where they went.
done: The Redhand left the mill for Wickham Keep. Osric Hale has opened his ledger to a clean page.
